title: GODFly v18.5
script:
--[================================================================]--
--  CodeGODFly V18.5 - Multi-Language Setup & Disclaimer GUI
--  Default Language: English
--  Features: Checkbox Agreement, Non-Draggable, Close Button
--  Delta Executor Optimized
--[================================================================]--

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService      = game:GetService("HttpService")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local CONFIG_FILE = "CodeGODFly_Setup_Done.json"

-- 再ログイン確認（すでにセットアップ済みの場合は終了）
local function isSetupDone()
    if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
        local ok, data = pcall(readfile, CONFIG_FILE)
        if ok and data then
            local decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(data) end)
            if decoded then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

if isSetupDone() then
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/4pLqXB6u/raw"))()
        end)
    end)
    return
end

local function getHiddenParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, hui = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and hui then return hui end
    end
    local ok, cg = pcall(function() return CoreGui end)
    if ok and cg then return cg end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local ScreenGuiName = "CodeGODFly_Setup_Wizard"
pcall(function()
    local ex = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(ScreenGuiName)
    if ex then ex:Destroy() end
end)
do
    local ex2 = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild(ScreenGuiName)
    if ex2 then ex2:Destroy() end
end
if gethui then
    pcall(function()
        local hui = gethui()
        local ex3 = hui:FindFirstChild(ScreenGuiName)
        if ex3 then ex3:Destroy() end
    end)
end

local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
sg.Name = ScreenGuiName
sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
sg.DisplayOrder = 1000
sg.Parent = getHiddenParent()

-- 多言語辞書（初期は英語をデフォルト表示に）
local texts = {
    EN = {
        title = "CodeGODFly V18.5 Setup Wizard",
        steps = {
            [1] = "[Cache Notice]\nCodeGODFly v18.5 has a cache feature, but it may not work depending on your executor.\nIf it fails, please open the 'CodeGODFly_SearchResults' folder manually and cache images yourself.",
            [2] = "[Disclaimer]\nUse at your own risk. We take no responsibility if you get kicked or banned.\nThis script's main feature is Fly, alongside numerous sub-features. We accept absolute zero responsibility for any bans resulting from its use.",
            [3] = "[Sub-Features]\n- FTAP Anti-Kick (Default OFF. Say 'ON' or 'off' in chat to toggle)\n- Lava Rising Tower Anti-Cheat Destruction (Cannot be toggled)\n- Lava Rising Tower Anti-Damage Block & Anti-Lava (Cannot be toggled)",
            [4] = "[Main Fly Features]\nDesigned for flying with Noclip enabled.\nAdjust speed using plus/minus buttons, or click the speed display box to enter a custom value."
        },
        langName = "English",
        agreeText = "I agree to the terms above",
        nextBtn = "Next Step"
    },
    JP = {
        title = "CodeGODFly V18.5 セットアップ",
        steps = {
            [1] = "【キャッシュ機能について】\nこのCodeGODFly v18.5はキャッシュ機能がありますが、エグゼキューターによっては機能しません。\nその場合は、自分で『CodeGODFly_SearchResults』フォルダを開き、手動でキャッシュしてください。",
            [2] = "【免責事項】\nこのスクリプトを使ってゲームからキックやBANをされても自己責任です。通報されても責任は一切取りません。\nこのスクリプトはFlyがメインですが、サブ機能がありえないほどあります。どの機能を使用してもBAN等の責任は絶対に負いません。",
            [3] = "【サブ機能の説明】\n・Fling Things and People用アンチキック（初期OFF。チャットで「ON」と言うとオン、「off」でオフになります）\n・Lava Rising Tower add tire用アンチチート破壊システム（大体破壊できます。オンオフ不可）\n・Lava Rising Tower add tire用アンチダメージブロック＆アンチ溶岩（オンオフ不可）",
            [4] = "【本編機能（Fly）の説明】\nこのスクリプトは空を飛ぶためのものです。Noclip（すり抜け）があります。\nスピードを変更するには、プラス＆マイナスボタンを使うか、速度表示のテキストボックスを直接押して数値を入力できます。"
        },
        langName = "日本語",
        agreeText = "上記の規約に同意します",
        nextBtn = "次へ進む"
    },
    CN = {
        title = "CodeGODFly V18.5 设置向导",
        steps = {
            [1] = "【关于缓存功能】\n此 CodeGODFly v18.5 拥有缓存功能，但某些注入器可能无法正常工作。\n如果失效，请自行打开 'CodeGODFly_SearchResults' 文件夹进行缓存。",
            [2] = "【免责声明】\n使用此脚本被踢出或封禁概不负责，举报亦不承担责任。\n本脚本主要核心为飞行，并包含大量子功能。无论使用哪个功能导致封禁，本作者绝对不承担任何责任。",
            [3] = "【子功能说明】\n- FTAP 防踢功能（默认关闭。在聊天中输入 ON 开启，off 关闭）\n- Lava Rising Tower 防作弊破坏系统（不可开关）\n- Lava Rising Tower 防伤方块与防熔岩（不可开关）",
            [4] = "【核心飞行功能】\n本脚本用于空中飞行，附带穿墙（Noclip）。\n可通过加减按钮调整速度，或直接点击速度文本框输入数值。"
        },
        langName = "中文",
        agreeText = "我同意以上条款",
        nextBtn = "下一步"
    }
}

local currentLang = "EN" -- 初期設定を英語に
local currentStep = 1
local maxSteps = 4
local isAgreed = false

-- メインウィンドウ（ドラッグ不可・固定配置）
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 310)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -155)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Parent = sg

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = main

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Parent = main

-- ヘッダー
local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = main

local hCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
hCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
hCorner.Parent = header

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = texts[currentLang].title
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 13
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.Parent = header

-- 閉じるボタン（Xボタン）
local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0.5, -15)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.Text = "✕"
closeBtn.TextSize = 13
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.Parent = header

local cCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
cCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
cCorner.Parent = closeBtn

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sg:Destroy()
end)

-- 言語切り替えボタン
local langBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
langBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 26)
langBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0.5, -13)
langBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
langBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 255)
langBtn.Text = "🌐 " .. texts[currentLang].langName
langBtn.TextSize = 11
langBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
langBtn.Parent = header

local lbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
lbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
lbCorner.Parent = langBtn

-- コンテンツエリア（説明文）
local contentBox = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
contentBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -145)
contentBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 50)
contentBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
contentBox.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
contentBox.ScrollBarThickness = 4
contentBox.Parent = main

local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 140)
descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
descLabel.Text = texts[currentLang].steps[currentStep]
descLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 225)
descLabel.TextSize = 13
descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
descLabel.TextWrapped = true
descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
descLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
descLabel.Parent = contentBox

-- ステップインジケーター
local stepIndicator = Instance.new("TextLabel")
stepIndicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 20)
stepIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -80)
stepIndicator.BackgroundTransparency = 1
stepIndicator.Text = "Step " .. currentStep .. " / " .. maxSteps
stepIndicator.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
stepIndicator.TextSize = 11
stepIndicator.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
stepIndicator.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
stepIndicator.Parent = main

-- チェックマーク同意エリア
local checkboxContainer = Instance.new("TextButton")
checkboxContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 26)
checkboxContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -55)
checkboxContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
checkboxContainer.Text = ""
checkboxContainer.Parent = main

local checkBox = Instance.new("Frame")
checkBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
checkBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -10)
checkBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
checkBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
checkBox.Parent = checkboxContainer

local cbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
cbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
cbCorner.Parent = checkBox

local cbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
cbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
cbStroke.Thickness = 1.2
cbStroke.Parent = checkBox

local checkMark = Instance.new("TextLabel")
checkMark.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
checkMark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
checkMark.Text = "✓"
checkMark.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
checkMark.TextSize = 14
checkMark.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
checkMark.Visible = false
checkMark.Parent = checkBox

local checkLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
checkLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0)
checkLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0)
checkLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
checkLabel.Text = texts[currentLang].agreeText
checkLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
checkLabel.TextSize = 12
checkLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
checkLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
checkLabel.Parent = checkboxContainer

-- チェックボックス切り替え処理
checkboxContainer.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isAgreed = not isAgreed
    checkMark.Visible = isAgreed
end)

-- 次へ進むボタン
local agreeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
agreeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30)
agreeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -165, 1, -22)
agreeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
agreeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
agreeBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].nextBtn
agreeBtn.TextSize = 12
agreeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
agreeBtn.Parent = main

local agCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
agCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
agCorner.Parent = agreeBtn

-- 画面更新関数
local function updateUI()
    local t = texts[currentLang]
    titleLabel.Text = t.title
    langBtn.Text = "🌐 " .. t.langName
    descLabel.Text = t.steps[currentStep]
    stepIndicator.Text = "Step " .. currentStep .. " / " .. maxSteps
    checkLabel.Text = t.agreeText
    if currentStep == maxSteps then
        agreeBtn.Text = t.nextBtn .. " & Launch"
        agreeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    else
        agreeBtn.Text = t.nextBtn
        agreeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
    end
end

-- 言語切り替えクリック処理（EN -> JP -> CN -> EN）
langBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if currentLang == "EN" then
        currentLang = "JP"
    elseif currentLang == "JP" then
        currentLang = "CN"
    else
        currentLang = "EN"
    end
    updateUI()
end)

-- 次へボタンクリック処理（チェックが入っていないと進めない）
agreeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isAgreed then
        -- 未チェック時の注意演出（文字を赤くする等）
        checkLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        task.delay(0.5, function()
            checkLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
        end)
        return
    end

    if currentStep < maxSteps then
        currentStep = currentStep + 1
        isAgreed = false
        checkMark.Visible = false
        updateUI()
    else
        -- すべての同意完了：ファイルに記録（再ログイン時非表示）
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({ setupCompleted = true }))
            end
        end)
        
        sg:Destroy()
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/4pLqXB6u/raw"))()
            end)
        end)
    end
end)

updateUI()
print("[CodeGODFly Setup] Loaded (English Default)")
features: This script is FLY, just FLY, I've reposted it, I'll explain for now, this script comes with instructions, this FLY, noclip and image search, the image search is still in beta, I think the image search function is the best part, that's all for now
